audience: operations teams that process invoices, statements and contracts as PDF files

useCases.title: Extract text from a scanned PDF
useCases.text: Run OCR on a PDF and get a link to a text file. The link stays active for about 60 minutes.

useCases.title: Find a term in a contract
useCases.text: Search a PDF for a text string or a regular expression, and get the page and position of each match.

useCases.title: Turn invoice tables into data
useCases.text: Convert the tables of a PDF to CSV, or parse an invoice with a saved parser template into JSON, YAML, XML or CSV.

useCases.title: Merge or split PDF files
useCases.text: Merge two to twenty public PDF links in a given order, or keep only the pages you name from a PDF.

useCases.title: Protect a copy with a password
useCases.text: Add or remove a password on a copy of a PDF. The source file does not change.

useCases.title: Check credits before a batch
useCases.text: Read the remaining credits and plan details before you run processing calls, which use credits.
